analyst_view.overall: Early view: FC Twente beat Excelsior 9-0 and outplayed Ajax in a 2-2 draw, and now host bottom side Willem II, who have 3 points, lost 7-0 at PSV and only drew 1-1 with PEC in Jurgen Streppel's first weeks. Twente travel to Freiburg in the Conference League four days later, so John van den Brom may rest one or two players.

goals.text: The numbers say 4 goals. I lean higher: Wout Weghorst scored four and Sondre Orjasaeter made five assists in the 9-0 two weeks ago, and Willem II have a goal difference of -29 after 12 games.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.8 corners. I lean higher: Willem II had no shots in the first half at PSV and will defend deep, and Twente produce many crosses for Weghorst; their first goal against Ajax came from a corner.

cards.text: The numbers say 3 cards. A one-sided game usually brings few home bookings and some for a chasing away side, which is what the split shows; nothing points elsewhere.

shots.text: The numbers say 35.7 shots, 28 of them Twente's. That is already huge; Twente's attack justifies it, but possible rotation before Freiburg stops me going higher.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.3 shots on target. Twente's finishing has been sharp, but Willem II's 2.6 looks generous, so the total balances out at about the estimate.
